headline: Google Gemini's 7 hidden features organize chaotic work tasks, from lock screen notes to automated searches
summary: Discover how Gemini's advanced capabilities, including lock screen voice notes and automated task creation, can streamline your daily workflow and manage information overload.
details: Initially skeptical of AI, one tech writer found Google Gemini indispensable for managing daily and work tasks. After experimenting with features like summarizing YouTube videos and screen sharing, Gemini proved more useful than anticipated, evolving into a utilitarian digital assistant.

A key feature is the ability to create voice notes directly from the lock screen on devices like the Pixel 9 Pro XL or Galaxy Tab S10 FE. This system-level capability, now expanded to Workspace extensions like Keep and Tasks, allows users to quickly capture thoughts without unlocking their phone, understanding natural conversational language.

While lock screen editing isn't yet supported, this feature significantly saves time and prevents ideas from being lost. Setup is straightforward via Gemini Settings, enabling instant dictation for fleeting thoughts or important information.

Gemini also excels at automating routine tasks, such as scouring the internet for news and deals. Users can create highly specific, recurring background tasks or custom 'Gems' to search for items with precise rules, like ignoring price cuts under a certain amount.

This flexible automation saves hours of manual searching across multiple retailers and can be applied to various categories beyond deals. Scheduled tasks can be set up through standard chat, Scheduled actions in settings, or with more nuanced rules using Gemini Gems.

The 'Ask Gemini' overlay with screen-sharing integration has become a superior alternative to Google Lens for visual data. It handles complex visual information and reduces steps in visual searches, proving more efficient for tasks like extracting details from images.

For scheduling, Gemini can extract relevant dates and times from chaotic schedules within emails or images. Users can then instruct it to create events directly in their calendar, and even surface their upcoming agenda from the lock screen, simplifying meeting management.
